risks.risk: Tyre condition/quality (cuts, dry rot, punctures) and whether wheels hold air.
risks.proof: A short clip of the seller inflating/pressing tyres and showing tread condition + a quick spin test of both wheels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres may need repair/patching (worst case: treat as not fully guaranteed).

risks.risk: Brakes and drivetrain condition (brake rub, weak braking, chain skipping).
risks.proof: Video of a full stop test from a short roll + close-up of chain and gear shifting (if any gears).
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes/drivetrain may need service (worst case: treat as not working perfectly).

risks.risk: Whether it truly comes with 'complete accessories' (helmet, pump, lock, lights, bell, etc.).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing every accessory laid out and counted (or a written checklist with photos of each item).
risks.if_unproven: Price as accessories are missing or incomplete.

risks.risk: Frame size/fit and whether it matches the buyer’s intended rider age/height.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size/seat tube measurement (tape measure) and seat height range.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic fat-tire bicycle without size certainty.

proof_requests: Show all accessories included (laid out) and confirm what is included in the package.
Video: braking test (front and rear) + drivetrain/chain test (pedal forward, shift if gears exist).
Close-up photos of tyres (tread + sidewalls) and a quick wheel spin test.
Measure/photograph frame size (seat tube length) and confirm rider height/age suitability.
response.reason: The photo confirms a fat-tire bicycle, but the key pricing drivers—accessories included, tyre/brake/drivetrain condition, and exact bicycle type/size—are not provable from the single image. Without those, a safe worst-case price pick from the comparables is not reliable.
